page.content:
Terroir, appellations, and tasting cultures that organize wine as living geography.

How Wine connects

  • Item: Vitis vinifera — Vitis vinifera is the grape species behind nearly all fine wine.
  • Topic: Terroir — Terroir is the idea that wine tastes of a particular place.
  • Topic: Old World wine — Old World wine is the European appellation tradition within wine.
  • Topic: New World wine — New World wine is the varietal-led tradition of the Americas and Antipodes.
  • Topic: Sommelier — The sommelier is the service profession that interprets wine for diners.

What is Wine?

Wine is fermented grape, almost always Vitis vinifera, talked about as place: Bordeaux and Burgundy, Champagne's bubbles, New World labels, and the AOC idea that a village name is a rule as much as a flavor.

Key threads lead to Vitis vinifera, Terroir, Old World wine, New World wine and Sommelier.
